claim_boundary: Internal five-fold diagnostic over 28,727 exact-unique pose sequences. All 415 sequences flagged as possible translated, scaled, or mirrored equivalents are kept with their geometry group, and static center/size means are excluded. The upstream left/right label meaning is undocumented, and original video, event, athlete, weapon, frame-rate, and source-video grouping are absent. Therefore this is label-predictability evidence only: it is not a referee model, an athlete-held-out or source-video-held-out benchmark, a fencing-side semantic validation, or deployment evidence.
evaluation_design: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by conservative transformation-invariant geometry hash
feature_policy: pose/pair visibility, motion, dispersion, range, and temporal delta; no static center or body-size means
model_artifact_policy: local-only; upstream pose provenance is undocumented
